Great Sports Bar
Oct 2025 • Couples
Hubby and I were in Saigon for 5 days here and wound up here on multiple occasions. Service is great, atmosphere is perfect expat/sports bar. Owner is so accommodating. We were happy to watch NFL on a Friday AM, accompanied by a spicy Bloody Mary and delish Eggs Benedict. If I could change anything I might have liked a mimosa (cheap Prosecco and oj), but that’s just me being high maintenance. Plenty of other options here. Highly recommended Phattys if you’re in the city looking for a casual sports bar.

If you are in Saigon this bar is a must
May 2025 • Friends
Stopped in Saigon 3 nights, just so happened to be on State of Origin Game One. The bar was very busy had many large screens. The owner
Put on a Sausage sizzle for half time. The sausages tasted just like Sausages in Australia. They came with bread onion and tomato sauce Best thing was they were free. The bar staff are great , service is excellent. Very quick. Called back the following night with a group of fellow travellers. I had Sea Bream Chios and rice. The fish was superb and the chips the best I have tasted for many years . The food is pub fare but good quality . Highly recommend
